title: Spotlight shadow on fog is only visible when a visible spotlight is in the scene on app start
body: ### Tested versions - reproducable in v4.7.stable.official [5b4e0cb0f], 4.6.3.stable ### System information Godot v4.7.stable - macOS Sequoia (15.7.5) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M1 (Apple7) - Apple M1 (8 threads) - 16.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description I had an issue with spotlight shadows not affecting fog and fixed that using Calinous comment in the post [SpotLight3D shadows don't affect Volumetric Fog #80039](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/80039). While fixing that, I found a separate issue, that's easily overlooked as its hiding behind report #80039 and will only show up if you launch the demo (not an issue in the editor) If a spotlight is visible in the scene at the start of the app it will have the occluder cast a shadow on the fog: (Note that the shadow is barely visible due to mentioned #80039 - but with Calinous fix this new issue is significant for us) If however the demo is launched, and the spotlight is added (or turned visible) later through an in-game event, the occluder wont cast a shadow: I used [dreadlocks-dude](https://github.com/dreadlocks-dude)s example project (just added a camera). ### Steps to reproduce This is a runtime issue, not testable in the editor: Missing shadow on fog: - Start the app - In the editor, turn on the spotlight in fog_test.tscn - Check in-app to 'see' missing shadow Shadow visible on fog: - (with the spotlight now turned visible in the editor) start the app - Check in-app to see shadow on the fog ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [SpotLight3DShadowIssue.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29971143/SpotLight3DShadowIssue.zip)
